svg.title: Foot and ankle pain: after a twisted ankle the Ottawa rules decide the X-ray; without injury the site of the pain separates Achilles tendinopathy and plantar fasciitis at the heel, tibialis posterior dysfunction at the medial ankle, bunion and Morton's neuroma in the forefoot, and the diabetic foot; each column gives presentation, workup and treatment
